preconditions.description: The number of rows must be greater than zero.
The number of columns must be greater than zero.

postconditions.description: The number of rows in the returned chessboard must match the input rows.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == columns for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each row in the returned chessboard must have the same number of columns as specified.

postconditions.expression: all(cell in ['O', 'X'] for row in return_value for cell in row)
postconditions.description: Each cell in the returned chessboard must be either 'O' or 'X'.
The first cell of the chessboard must be 'O'.

postconditions.expression: all((i + j) % 2 == 0 if cell == 'O' else (i + j) % 2 != 0 for i, row in enumerate(return_value) for j, cell in enumerate(row))
postconditions.description: The cells must alternate between 'O' and 'X' in a checkerboard pattern.
